Import selected profile and reasons; platform policy may only require a stricter profile.
Map exact role IDs and intersect permissions with platform/workspace/repository policy.
Local checkpoint evidence is historical only and never grants new platform authority.
Import verdicts as evidence; the receiving platform independently validates before publication.
